title: pass owner from package.json team in core-shell, billing, reports (mono)

summary: validateApp now throws if owner is missing/empty/blank. core-shell (platform), billing (payments), reports (insights) pass owner matching their package.json team. Assumptions: owner hardcoded as literal matching package.json team (apps can't import package.json in the bundle); shared-contracts is a monorepo lib inlined at build, so one PR; platform-kit untouched. Reports isn't built by CI/CD but was built locally OK. PR #1 merged, CI and CD green.
